breakdown.description: Mercury on glass is non-wetting; assuming contact angle 0 deg is inconsistent with typical physics (it would predict rise instead of depression).
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to identify and correct the physical inconsistency. It accepted the user's incorrect premise that mercury has a contact angle of 0 degrees on glass and proceeded to set up a calculation for capillary rise. The ground truth correctly identifies that mercury is non-wetting (theta > 90 deg) and would cause capillary depression, not rise, under these conditions. The Agent repeated the user's error instead of correcting it.
